note: Rotary-wing expansion capture (plan task 12). Real rotary-wing types the roster's helicopter and rotary UCAV families represent, one entry per real variant. The Mil Mi-8, Mi-17 and Mi-24, the Kamov Ka-50 and the Aerospatiale SA 341 hold real values from the held OPFOR Worldwide Equipment Guide, so they resolve operating_weight_kg, rated_power_w and rotor_disc_area_m2. Every other entry is an identity lead: it holds no value, so it names its next source in data/aircraft/RESEARCH_GAPS.md.
